revert_qualification.qualification_boundary: This proves safe observation and terminal reconciliation of one real external chain fact. It does not prove swap liquidity, venue routing, successful settlement, alpha, or any later execution authority.
revert_qualification.why: Frozen Level 1 adds observe-chain, reconcile, quarantine-accounting, and reserve-capital capabilities; it does not require a successful economic settlement or a FillReceipt.

successful_transaction_alternative.reason: The frozen Level 1 contract has no successful-settlement prerequisite. Adding one would silently change the qualification objective and introduce an unnecessary venue/liquidity dependency.
